description: Every article and news item EKO-IKSI clinic has published, newest first, page by page: title, type, date and link. `type` picks the blog (article), the news (news) or both; follow `next_page` until it is null to see them all. Use search_articles to find one by topic and read_article for the text.

language.description: Language of the answer: uz (Uzbek, the site's own language and the default), ru (Russian) or en (English).

per_page.description: Publications per page (default and at most 50).

type.description: article (the blog), news, or any (the default).

name: list_articles
title: List articles
